topic: What trade-offs exist between array size and radiation efficiency for SIW arrays in high-gain inter-satellite antennas?
consensus_response: The trade-off between array size and radiation efficiency is rooted in the physical mechanism of increased directivity, which comes at the cost of higher sidelobe levels and mutual coupling effects. As array size increases, insertion loss due to longer SIW structures leads to decreased radiation efficiency. Phased array feeding can optimize insertion loss by distributing power across multiple feeding points, but careful design of the feed network is required to minimize losses and ensure good matching between feeds and antenna elements.
